summary: Master advanced customer segmentation techniques with our comprehensive course. Improve your marketing strategies and connect with your audience better.
lede: Customer segmentation helps marketing, product, sales, and customer-experience professionals group and prioritize customers based on meaningful differences. The training covers demographic, psychographic, and behavioral approaches, customer data sources, clustering and RFM models, and persona validation. Participants learn to apply segment insights to campaigns, product and service decisions, and resource allocation while considering data bias and privacy.
audienceIntro: This segmentation strategy course is designed for professionals who must understand and act on customer insights:
modules: Segmentation in Product and Service Design
